description: This Java source file contains step definitions for Cucumber BDD tests, providing reusable actions and assertions related to user login and navigation in the OrangeHRM application.

classes.name: CommonSteps
classes.description: Contains step definitions for common user actions and assertions used across multiple test scenarios in the OrangeHRM UI automation project.

methods.name: loginWith
methods.description: Performs login with specified username and password.

methods.name: dashboardVisible
methods.description: Asserts that the dashboard is visible after login.

methods.name: invalidCreds
methods.description: Checks that invalid login credentials message is shown.

methods.name: requiredValidation
methods.description: Checks for required field validation message on login form.

methods.name: openDashboard
methods.description: Opens the Dashboard module via the side menu.

methods.name: openPim
methods.description: Opens the PIM module via the side menu.

methods.name: openLeave
methods.description: Opens the Leave module via the side menu.

methods.name: openRecruitment
methods.description: Opens the Recruitment module via the side menu.

methods.name: openTime
methods.description: Opens the Time module via the side menu.

methods.name: openAdmin
methods.description: Opens the Admin module via the side menu.

methods.name: assertDashboardAccessible
methods.description: Verifies that the Dashboard is accessible.
